title: Canon in D
short: Johann Pachelbel · D 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: The left hand plays the same eight bass notes over and over, two bars at a time, just as the cello does in Pachelbel’s piece. Learn that pattern first: it never changes. Then add the right hand, which plays the first violin part: slow notes at first, then flowing eighth notes.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: Canon and Gigue in D major for three violins and bass (date unknown, about 1680–1706): the opening

sources.name: Notes checked note by note against the score of the opening on Wikipedia’s “Pachelbel’s Canon” page (violin I and cello). We keep those two lines for bars 1 to 10 and add a final D chord.
